title: Behavior fixture envelope
description: Shape of a behavior fixture conformance/fixtures/** (except schemas/, manifests/ and state-machine/, which have their own shape). The meaning of the fields, the closed list of step verbs, the actor grammar and the execution order are written in conformance/runner.md. A fixture is data: the implementation's runner builds port calls from it and compares the expectations.

case.description: A fixture or one of its cases. A case inherits the parent's given and adds its own; a case without steps checks the result of seeding given.

version.description: Skeleton version from which the case applies.

given.description: Initial state of the test bench: tenant, people with groups and permissions, manifests, records. Keys other than tenant and people are seed data; the runner seeds them through the normal paths (P2 apply and P1, P2 calls), not through the test-control port.

tenant.description: Tenant on whose behalf the steps run: a name, or a record with a name and fields of the tenant manifest (kind and others).

step.description: Step: exactly one verb from the closed list (call, stand, model, lint, occur, check) plus modifiers.

model.description: What the mock model returns behind P4 in this step (spec/bindings/model-providers/mock.md): the answer text, tool calls or other answer data.

lint.description: Manifest fragments that the runner submits to P2 apply without applying them, or to the implementation's lint; the expectation is usually stage: lint or apply.

occur.description: A core event that the fixture states as an outcome rather than a call (for example, a child task closed). The runner brings it about with normal P1, P2 and test-control port calls; the runner chooses the path.

check.description: Observation point without an action: what the runner reads (a record, a delivery, a state) before comparing the step's expect.

chat.description: Chat from which the person acts (the channel's Botaru-Chat header).

card.description: Card kind from spec/model/decision-points.yaml whose button made the step.

on_behalf.description: Identity for the Botaru-On-Behalf header instead of the identity of the person in by (conformance/runner.md).

message.description: Channel message for the Botaru-Message header of a button press: an external id or other (another message of the same chat). Without the field the runner takes the external_id of the card's delivery.

credential.description: Call credentials instead of the actor's usual ones, for example someone else's token.

lease.description: Lease token for the Botaru-Lease header: a token object (epoch, work_id, lease_no, worker_id) or a handle, current (the actor's current lease) or stale (an earlier lease of the same work). Without the field the runner takes the actor's current lease. The signature (key_id, sig) is optional and the runner does not compute it: with signed tokens the object selects a core-issued token with these fields, and without such a token the fields go with the signature of the current lease (conformance/runner.md).

context.description: Step conditions that are not in the request body: fields of the attempt, task, actor or record (initiator, task type, untrusted text in the context, data mark, call path). The keys name fields of the spec/model schemas; the runner establishes them before the step through seeding and earlier steps, like the keys of given (conformance/runner.md, section "Steps").

at.description: When the step is made: a UTC instant or an offset from the start of the fixture. The runner turns it into T clock.set or clock.advance before the step.

call.description: Call of a port operation from the map spec/ports/operations.yaml. request is the body per the operation's request schema; the runner expands short ids and people handles per conformance/runner.md.

stand.description: Test bench action through port T (spec/ports/test-control.md). The other keys are the operation's arguments.

expect.description: Expectation as data. Closed fields: result, reason, stage, outcome, state, note. The other keys are observable facts: a record or field name and the expected value; a fact the runner cannot check is marked unchecked, not passed.

result.description: Outcome of the call: ok, a rule refusal (rejected) or a C2 permission refusal (denied).

reason.description: Reason code of the refusal or outcome from spec/model/reasons.yaml.

stage.description: Stage of the refusal: schema (body or manifest schema), lint (manifest lint), apply (applying the set), hold (holds in the C2 decision order), ban (unconditional prohibition in the C2 decision order).

outcome.description: An outcome that is neither ok nor a refusal, for example staged, enqueued, skipped.

state.description: State of the subject after the step per its lifecycle in spec/lifecycles/.

error.description: Stable lint or apply error code for a refusal with stage lint or apply; the skeleton's manifest lint codes are listed in ci/lint_codes.py (table in ci/README.md).

actor.description: Step actor or a subject in given per the grammar of conformance/runner.md.
